provenance: Synthetic numerical regression start for 30-degree slope and 0-to-40-cm one-wheel stability, checked 2026-10-14. A shortened 0.50 m arm and 0.49 m wheelbase, 0.64 m track and 0.22 m drums give a feasible start with interior stability and clearance reserves. Other values use reference defaults. A small scaled COBYLA initial radius avoids the invalid trials seen with its default radius; derivative-checked optimization must succeed, finish feasible and improve score. All physical constraints, solver tolerance and assertions are retained. SLSQP cold-start and unsuccessful reference runs remain explicitly failed; this fixture demonstrates a supported alternate solver instead of turning those failures into passes. Explicit wheel coefficient 8 kg/m^2, slope pi/6 and rock 0.40 m preserve current requirements. Not hardware/calibration data or proof of a global optimum.
